title: Kaila Napolis claims bronze for PH's first jiu jitsu medal in 2026 Asiad
summary: Kaila Napolis secured a bronze medal in the 2026 Asian Games on Friday, injecting some spark into the campaign of the jiu jitsu team that has been rocked by early exits of world champions.
